(1) a bidirectional approach to IE is feasible; (2) it outperforms state-of-the-art approaches on two IE tasks, entity identification and relation classification, and citation matching; and (3) it can be used to solve other IE problems.

(a) we propose a joint paradigm for IE tasks that can capture mutual benefits among relevant subtasks and (b) we present a novel learning algorithm that can exploit bidirectional information flow to optimize the joint model.

the following questions: (1) Can we jointly solve multiple subtasks in IE? (2) Can we exploit rich dependencies and bidirectional information flow between relevant subtasks? and (3) Can we design a learning algorithm to effectively and efficiently solve such a joint IE task?
